prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident claim — the right attorney depends on the type and severity of your injuries, the complexity of liability, whether you want a quickly negotiated settlement or a firm that will take cases to trial, language preferences, location in Chicago, and your budget. I can help you find a lawyer who’s a good fit. Before that, a few practical points to guide your choice and next steps.

Quick checklist of what matters most
- Experience with car-accident and auto-liability claims (not just general practice). Ask how many cases like yours they’ve handled.  
- Trial experience and verdicts — many claims settle, but you want someone willing and able to try the case if needed.  
- Track record of settlements/verdicts for similar injuries (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic).  
- Communication: how often you’ll be updated and who you’ll deal with day-to-day.  
- Fee structure: most PI attorneys work on contingency (commonly about 33%–40% of recovery), but confirm specifics and any costs you might owe if you lose.  
- Reputation and discipline: check Bar standing and any disciplinary history (Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission).  
- Availability and resources: for serious cases, you want a firm with investigators, medical expert access, and litigation resources.  
- Local experience: knowledge of Chicago courts, judges, and local insurers can help.

Important practical facts
- Illinois personal-injury statute of limitations for negligence is generally 2 years from the date of injury (735 ILCS 5/13-202). Don’t wait to consult an attorney if your deadline is approaching.  
- Gather evidence before meeting: police report, photos of the scene/vehicles/injuries, medical records and bills, contact info for witnesses, insurance information.

What to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? Outcome examples?  
- What is your contingency fee and what expenses are deducted from my recovery?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- Will you take my case to trial if necessary? What is your trial win/loss record?  
- Can you provide client references or reviews?

How I can help now
If you want, tell me:
- Brief details about the accident and injuries (minor, moderate, catastrophic),  
- Which Chicago neighborhood you’re in or prefer,  
- Any language or scheduling needs,  
and I’ll compile a short list (3–5) of highly rated Chicago personal-injury attorneys or firms that fit your situation, with links to reviews and contact info.
